label: McAnaw
basis: Mike, from several sources, to be listed. The family was Irish speaking and mostly illiterate in the 1800s, so there was no correct spelling.
observed_in: Druminnin: six McKenna entries in the Griffith's index, and McAna, McAnaw, McNaw and McNan in the 1901, 1911 and 1926 censuses
notes: Modern spelling McAnaw. The label is a handle and not a correction.
